chapters.label: Paris, 2006
chapters.text: Paris, 2006, the Champions League final, in pouring rain. Barcelona trail Arsenal. Larsson flicks it on, and Samuel Eto'o is already sprinting in behind. Goal!

chapters.label: Level
chapters.text: Watch again. Eto'o waits level with the last defender: level is onside! Arsenal said offside, but the flag stayed down. Then he bursts past Eboué, into the space.

chapters.label: Near post
chapters.text: From behind the goal: low and hard, past Almunia at the near post.

chapters.label: Time your run
chapters.text: Time your run so you're onside, then sprint in behind the defence!
